term.label: circular_mRNA

definition.text: An mRNA that is generated by backsplicing of exons or introns, resulting in a covalently closed loop without a 5’ cap or 3’ polyA tail.

comments: Added as per GitHub Issue Request #490 (https://github.com/The-Sequence-Ontology/SO-Ontologies/issues/490) and GitHub Issue Request #391 (https://github.com/The-Sequence-Ontology/SO-Ontologies/issues/391)
